decisions.audio_batching: reject_enablement_noop: batching is already compiled on with batch size 128; the prior audio-off frame screen was neutral/slower
decisions.animation_parallel_enablement: reject_noops: evaluation, update, interpolation, and physics blend are already parallel
decisions.force_parallel_animation: reject_unsafe: it overrides asset/project opt-outs and the previous forced-URO experiment regressed
decisions.core_tick_parallelism: do_not_queue_without_late-PvP trace attribution: ordering and task-overhead risk exceed cold-boot evidence
decisions.FX.EarlyScheduleAsync: queue isolated value-1 candidate behind cold-start, visual, and matched late-PvP frame-tail gates
decisions.fx.Niagara.SystemSimulation.TickBatchSiz: queue isolated value-8 candidate to test lower task overhead; require matched late-PvP tails and effect timing
decisions.boundary: Neither queued candidate is promoted or credited with FPS. Static defaults only establish that the changes are non-noop and supported by the shipped binary.
